findings.description: Logging at the LOG_DEBUG level can expose sensitive information if the log message contains user data, credentials, or other confidential information.
Using LOG_DEBUG in production environments can lead to excessive logging, performance issues, and information leakage.
If the log message is constructed using user input without proper formatting, it could lead to format string vulnerabilities.
